jobs.title: Learning & Development Lead, Operations
jobs.description:
**Learning & Development Lead — Operations**

**Role Overview**

The Learning & Development Lead owns training and readiness for Physical Intelligence's robot operator workforce.

This person is responsible for designing and running the systems that take a new operator from candidate work trial through their first 30–60 days, with the goal of getting people productive quickly while maintaining a high quality bar.

They also own ongoing training as the work changes. When researchers introduce new robot workflows, tasks, tools, or operating procedures, the Learning & Development Lead translates those changes into training that can be rolled out quickly and consistently across the operation.

This is a highly operational training role. We are looking for someone who has built or owned training programs for hourly or frontline employees and knows how to turn complex work into a simple, repeatable learning process.

**Responsibilities**

**Operator Trials & Readiness**

* Own the operator work-trial program and ensure candidates are evaluated consistently.
* Maintain clear trial standards, evaluator guidance, and scoring criteria.
* Partner with recruiting and operations to continuously improve what the trial predicts about future operator success.

**New-Hire Onboarding**

* Build and run onboarding from day one through the first 30–60 days.
* Define what an operator should know and be able to do at each stage of ramp.
* Create training plans, checklists, certification steps, and readiness milestones.
* Identify struggling operators early and create clear paths for remediation.
* Continuously improve time-to-productivity for new hires.

**New Workflow Training**

* Partner with researchers and operations teams when new robot tasks, systems, or processes are introduced.
* Learn new workflows quickly and translate them into clear training materials and operating instructions.
* Design the rollout plan needed to train a large operator population quickly.
* Track who has been trained and verify that the training actually resulted in correct execution.
* Maintain consistency as training expands across shifts, teams, and locations.

**Training Operations**

* Maintain a clear training calendar and ensure training happens when required.
* Coordinate trainers, operators, shift leads, and researchers.
* Keep training materials current as workflows change.
* Build repeatable processes so training does not depend on tribal knowledge.
* Track training completion, readiness, and performance metrics.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Use operator performance data and feedback to identify gaps in training.
* Work with operations leaders to understand recurring quality or productivity issues.
* Determine whether problems are caused by training, instructions, process, tooling, or something else.
* Continuously simplify and improve how operators learn.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience owning training, onboarding, or workforce development programs for hourly or frontline employees.
* Demonstrated ability to get new employees productive quickly.
* Experience building structured ramp programs with clear milestones and standards.
* Strong operational organization and follow-through.
* Able to turn ambiguous or technical workflows into simple, teachable processes.
* Comfortable managing trainers, who are responsible for training large groups of people on new procedures under tight timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Able to work effectively with both highly technical stakeholders, trainers, and frontline operators.
* Comfortable in an environment where processes and requirements change frequently.
* Uses data and observation to improve training rather than relying only on subjective feedback.

Experience in robotics is not required.

*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Citrin Cooperman offers a dynamic work environment, fostering professional growth and collaboration. We’re continuously seeking talented individuals who bring a problem-solving mindset, fresh perspectives, and sharp technical expertise. We know you have choices, so our team of collaborative, innovative professionals are ready to support your professional development. At Citrin Cooperman, we offer competitive compensation and benefits and most importantly, the flexibility to manage your personal and professional life to focus on what matters most to you!

We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Operations Manager who also acts as the Delivery Manager for infrastructure projects. You will run the infrastructure intake process, track critical projects through to delivery, and provide timely, accurate metrics and status reporting to stakeholders. You will work closely with operations, engineering, vendors, and business teams so that infrastructure initiatives (migrations, upgrades, data center moves, new site rollouts) are well governed, visible, and delivered on schedule.

**Responsibilities are, but not limited to:**

* Design, document, and continuously refine the Infrastructure Projects Intake process, including request channels, intake forms and templates, triage and prioritization criteria, approval gates, SLAs, roles and responsibilities, and workflows (e.g., in ServiceNow, Jira, or Azure DevOps).
* Own and run the Infrastructure Intake process day to day, from request submission through triage, assessment, prioritization, and approval, working with architects, engineers, and security to validate scope, effort, dependencies, and risk.
* Maintain the intake queue and backlog, communicate decisions and timelines to requestors, and convert approved requests into projects with clear scope, owners, and milestones.
* Manage delivery of infrastructure projects from initiation through planning, execution, cutover, hypercare, and handover to operations, including cloud migrations, data center moves, server and storage refreshes, network and SD-WAN upgrades, DR implementation, and new site rollouts.
* Build and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and resource plans; apply the right methodology (Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid); run stage gates and project reviews; and manage scope changes through formal change control.
* Lead go-live readiness reviews and cutover planning, including operational acceptance criteria, test and rollback plans, change windows, and hypercare, so that new infrastructure is fully supportable before handover.
* Track all critical projects in a consolidated view, monitoring milestones, dependencies, and risks, and escalate slippage early with clear impact analysis and recommended actions.
* Maintain the infrastructure project portfolio and roadmap, forecast resource and capacity demand across teams and vendors, and align priorities with business needs, architecture standards, and the technology strategy.
* Define, collect, and publish delivery and operations metrics (project health, intake cycle times and backlog, on-time and on-budget rates, availability, MTTR, change success rate, patch compliance, vendor SLA performance) through dashboards and scorecards in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or ServiceNow.
* Produce timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly status reports with RAG status, risks, issues, decisions needed, and upcoming milestones, plus executive summaries for steering committees and leadership reviews.
* Maintain stakeholder communication plans, RACI, and escalation paths, and coordinate business notifications and downtime approvals for planned changes and cutovers.
* Coordinate with operations teams so projects transition smoothly into support with runbooks, monitoring, and knowledge articles in place; participate in the Change Advisory Board (CAB); and follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, and configuration processes, including CMDB accuracy.
* Track major incidents and problem records that affect projects or service levels, and follow root cause analysis (RCA) corrective actions through to closure.
* Coordinate with vendors, MSPs, cloud providers, and carriers on deliverables and timelines, and track and report on vendor performance against contracts and SLAs.
* Plan, schedule, and run Disaster Recovery (DR) tests, coordinating application owners, infrastructure teams, and vendors; document results, gaps, and remediation actions; and report DR readiness against RTO/RPO targets.
* Work with Information Security to ensure delivered infrastructure meets security standards, support audits and compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR), and maintain risk registers.
* Track technology lifecycle and capacity, including end-of-life and end-of-support risk, license and contract renewals, and refresh planning, and feed the findings into the intake pipeline and roadmap.
* Close out projects with formal sign-off, post-implementation reviews, lessons learned, documentation handover, and benefits realization tracking.
* Track project and operational budgets, forecasts, and cloud costs (FinOps), and continuously improve intake, delivery, and reporting processes, promoting automation and Infrastructure as Code.

**The ideal candidate must:**

* Have a bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience (required).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher; PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification (PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe) preferred.
* Having cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and ISO 27001 awareness are a plus.
* Have 8-12+ years in IT infrastructure, including experience running infrastructure projects and programs.
* Possess a proven track record managing and delivering medium to large infrastructure projects (migrations, data center moves, refreshes, network transformations).
* Have experience operating an intake or demand management process for infrastructure or IT requests.
*

We have leveraged our expertise and capabilities both to commercialize three vaccines, including the world’s first and only chikungunya vaccine, and to rapidly advance a broad range of vaccine candidates into and through the clinic, including candidates against Lyme disease and Zika.

Valneva USA is focused on the marketing and distribution of vaccines for Japanese encephalitis and chikungunya.

The Senior Business Operations Manager serves as a U.S. strategic leader responsible for overseeing 3PL and end-to-end vaccine logistics operations across the market. This role drives operational excellence by optimizing distribution networks, enhancing supply reliability, and delivering sustainable cost efficiencies while ensuring full compliance with FDA, CDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

As a key member of the U.S. leadership team, this position aligns logistics and commercial operations with broader corporate strategy to support product launches, government contracting, and ongoing lifecycle management within the vaccine portfolio. The role champions cross-functional collaboration across Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, and Global Supply teams to ensure seamless execution.

With a strong focus on scalability and agility, the Senior Business Operations Manager leverages data-driven insights, process standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies to strengthen supply continuity, mitigate risk, and enable long-term growth in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment.

Requirements

**U.S. Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the U.S. strategic lead for business operations and vaccine logistics, aligning supply chain, finance, commercial, quality, and global teams to deliver operational excellence.
* Provide executive-level performance reporting and insights to the U.S. Head to ensure leadership alignment and data-driven decision-making.
* Lead U.S. contracting operations across government (including Military) and private market partnerships, overseeing financial analytics, compliance, and execution performance.

**Supply Chain & 3PL Oversight (Key Qualification)**

* Own end-to-end U.S. vaccine supply chain strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives and full compliance with GMP, FDA, and State Board of Pharmacy requirements (serving as Designated Representative nationwide).
* Oversee 3PL distribution operations, including inbound/outbound logistics, cold-chain integrity, inventory control, returns management, and sales order administration.
* Partner with global supply chain on demand planning, transfer pricing, U.S. Customs coordination, and inventory optimization to minimize expiry risk and protect supply continuity.
* Lead engagement with wholesalers and distributors, ensuring contract compliance, inventory discipline, issue resolution, and regulatory adherence.

* Oversee sales analytics and reporting infrastructure, managing data sources and remote analyst teams to deliver actionable insights.

**Quality & Compliance Leadership**

* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to maintain rigorous regulatory standards across 3PL and distribution operations both for the US and alignment globally.

**U.S. Business Operations Management**

Good team spirit in a strong and highly motivated team

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Member Services (Knowledge Management)
jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Manager, Member Journey & Knowledge Management owns two primary outcomes: the health of the Member Services knowledge base, and a complete, accurate picture of the end-to-end member journey — its processes, policies, and pain points. The ability to own and influence both, are paramount to the role.

This role documents and maps how the member journey actually works today, keeps the knowledge base that describes it accurate and trustworthy, and uses both to identify where Product can meaningfully improve the member experience, from the perspective of efficiency/effectiveness as well as automation where possible.

This is a deep, focused ownership role. Success means the knowledge base is clean and trusted for both human and AI agents, the journey is fully mapped and understood end-to-end, and Product team has a clear, evidence-based view into where to invest next.

**What you'll do:**

**Knowledge Base Health & Governance**

* Own the OneImaging knowledge base as the single source of truth.
* Own knowledge content lifecycle: identify and remediate outdated, duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned content.
* Establish and maintain the governance framework for content ownership, review cycles, approvals, and retirement.
* Define and maintain knowledge architecture: taxonomy, tagging, and organization to keep content findable.
* Monitor knowledge health: accuracy, freshness, duplication, content gaps, and search effectiveness.
* Ensure content is structured to support both human agents and AI-enabled support tools.
* Build reporting and dashboards that give leadership ongoing visibility into knowledge base health.

**End-to-End Member Journey Processes & Policies**

* Own documentation of the full member journey encompassing every process and policy a member touches from first contact through resolution.
* Partner with Business Owners and Product SMEs to validate that documented processes reflect actual practice.
* Ensure that when a process or policy changes, it's reflected consistently across all documentation and the knowledge base.
* Build and maintain visual, end-to-end process maps of the member journey across systems, teams, and handoffs.

**Product Enablement for Member Journey Improvement**

* Serve as the Member Services voice into Product: translate journey pain points, knowledge gaps, and operational friction into clear product opportunities.
* Analyze journey data, member feedback, and knowledge base usage to identify where product changes would most improve the member experience.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming product changes that affect the member journey and assess their downstream impact on processes and knowledge.
* Partner with Product to validate that shipped changes improve the member experience as intended.

**About you:**

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years in knowledge management, business process management, or journey/process mapping — preferably within Digital Health, Health Insurance, Radiology, or Tech-Enabled Healthcare Services.
* Proven experience owning a knowledge base end-to-end, including governance practices (ownership, review cycles, accuracy standards, retirement).
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining process maps (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) for complex, cross-functional workflows.
* Experience partnering with Product teams to translate operational or process insights into clear requirements or opportunities.
* Comfortable working without direct reports — able to drive outcomes by influencing SMEs, Product, and Operations partners.
* Experience with knowledge base and CRM/support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Notion).
* Highly self-directed, with the ability to build governance and mapping standards from first principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in radiology, medical imaging, or diagnostic services — clinical coordination, patient access, or operations.
* Familiarity with radiology workflows: prior authorization, imaging order management, payer-specific protocols, provider network coordination.
* Experience structuring knowledge content for AI-enabled support tools.

**Who You Are**

A systems thinker who instinctively maps how work actually flows before trying to fix it.

* Treats a messy knowledge base or an undocumented process as something to solve, not just flag.
* Keeps the member at the center of every process, policy, and product conversation — always asking "what does this feel like for the person on the other end?"
* Believes affordable, transparent healthcare access matters, and wants their work to be part of how OneImaging delivers on that promise.
* Data-driven but human-centered: uses journey and knowledge data to find problems, and judgment to prioritize fixes.

*The base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $115,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About UKON**

UKON exists to help every business survive a cyberattack.  
Formerly known as FifthWall Solutions, we have grown from our foundation as a specialized cyber insurance wholesaler into a full-service cyber revenue partner for independent insurance agencies and managed service providers. We give our partners the technology, processes, carrier access, and expertise they need to deliver sophisticated cyber capabilities without the cost and complexity of building an internal cyber department.  
Today, our team works inside our partners’ books of business to identify uninsured companies, understand their risk, secure the right coverage, and help get more businesses protected. With access to more than 50 carriers and differentiated coverage options, including custom endorsements for emerging risks such as agentic AI, we help businesses understand what they are buying and how their coverage will respond when they need it most.  
We are building the AI-native operating system that will make this work scalable. Our platform brings together fragmented agency data, cybersecurity context, carrier appetite, quoting, communications, and workflows to shorten the distance between an uninsured business and a protected one.  
For us, AI-native does not mean adding a chatbot to an existing product. It means embedding intelligence throughout the platform so the system can understand the context of a user’s work, recommend the right next action, and help complete that action within the workflow. Because we operate in insurance, we care as much about accuracy, reliability, auditability, data privacy, and user control as we do about model capability.  
Our mission is ambitious but simple: close the estimated $10 trillion cyber protection gap and ensure every business can survive a cyberattack.

**The Role**

You will be UKON's first Implementation Specialist, reporting to our executive team and working closely with our product, sales, and Cyber Practice Leaders (CPLs), teams. This is a greenfield role. You are being hired to build it.

UKON partners with independent insurance agencies and managed service providers to deliver an outsourced cyber practice. Signing a partnership is only the beginning. Implementation turns a signed agreement into an active, growing agency relationship: getting the agency onboarded, trained, connected to their CPL, and producing. Today that process runs on effort and goodwill. Your job is to turn it into a repeatable system.

You will design the agency onboarding standard, the handoff from sales to CPLs, the training standards, and the implementation playbook, and then run them. You will decide what good looks like, measure it, and keep improving it. This starts as an individual contributor role, with the opportunity to own and grow the implementation function as UKON scales.

Experience implementing technology and managing projects matters more to us than experience in insurance. If you’ve helped customers get up and running on a SaaS or technology product, kept projects on track, and built or improved the process along the way, we want to talk to you.

**What You'll Do**

* Build UKON's agency onboarding standard from the ground up, from signed agreement to active, producing partner.
* Design and run the handoff process between sales and Cyber Practice Leaders so nothing is lost between signature and launch.
* Create training standards and materials that get agencies and their producers confident and active quickly.
* Write and maintain the implementation playbook, including operating procedures, checklists, timelines, and escalation paths.
* Own the implementation pipeline for new agency partners and keep every account moving forward.
* Define implementation metrics, track progress, and report on what is working and what is not.
* Identify where agencies stall after signing and fix the root cause, whether it sits in process, product, or people.
* Partner with sales, CPLs, marketing, and product to feed agency feedback back into how we sell, support, and build.
* Use project management and AI tools to run implementation efficiently and at scale.

**What You Bring**

* At least 5 years of onboarding, implementation, or customer success experience with SaaS or technology products.
* A track record of building operating procedures and processes from scratch, not just following existing ones.
* Project management experience, including running multiple concurrent implementations with tools like Asana, Monday, ClickUp, or similar.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a process-driven, high-ownership approach to your work.
* The relational skill to work across sales, CPLs, and agency partners and earn their trust.
* Comfort coordinating and directing the work of others, even without formal authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn messy processes into simple, usable documentation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in insurance, insurtech, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with independent insurance agencies, agency management systems, or managed service providers.
* Exposure to product management or experience feeding customer input into a product roadmap.
* Experience as an early hire who built an implementation or onboarding function.
* A property and casualty insurance license, or interest in obtaining one.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Every new agency partner follows a clear, documented path from signed agreement to active production.
* Sales and CPLs trust the handoff process, and agencies feel supported from day one.
* More signed agencies become active, producing partners, and they get there faster.
* UKON has an implementation playbook that can scale as we add partners and team members.
* Leadership has clear visibility into implementation progress and where agencies need help.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Government
jobs.description:
For People is improving government digital services for the disadvantaged population. We work directly with government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

**Your Impact**
---------------

Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It hosts a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from across the agency, available for download, as interactive tools, and via a public API. As Program Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position **contingent** on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

**Our Culture**
---------------

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is ***100% remote***. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between **$100,000 and $160,000** annually. This band ranges across both the Program Manager and Senior Program Manager pay band, which will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

**Your Opportunities**
----------------------

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Program Manager, you will:

* Build a collaborative and trusting team culture across all disciplines in the program
* Run agile practices including sprints, planning cycles, demos, and retrospectives, all of which include CMS stakeholders
* Coordinate with CMS offices that publish data on the public portal; share progress transparently and build positive working relationships with partner contracting teams
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery
* Keep the program in line with contract, security, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and the site's Authority to Operate (ATO)
* Report status and outcomes to CMS and For People leadership, using live dashboards wherever possible and finding efficiency gains through automation
* Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months so users see no disruption

**You Bring**
-------------

* A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People’s values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
* 8+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
* Degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field
* Experience with open data projects
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead teams of 15 to 25 people as the contract grows
* Deep knowledge of agile product management principles
* Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub
* Ability to oversee all aspects of task order management including reporting, sprint planning, and project planning
* Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple government agency offices and data owners

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**
--------------------------------------

* Experience working directly with CMS programs or data
* Experience with public websites built on Drupal
* Experience leading a contract transition from an incumbent team

**Some Fine Print**
-------------------

You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.  
  
For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. This role is a key interface between the Customer Success team, Product, and Sales Engineering, and will balance program management, content creation, and execution.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**About the Role**

6sense is hiring a **Senior Digital Program Manager** to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

**What This Role Is – And Isn't**

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

* **You move fast and ship.** Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
* **You lead, not just execute.** You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
* **You flag blockers immediately.** Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
* **You own your backlog.** You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
* **You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission."** Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
* Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
* Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
* Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

**Digital Journey & Campaign Build**

* Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
* Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
* Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
* A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

**Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis**

* Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
* Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
* Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

**Gainsight Platform** **Leader**

* Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
* Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
* Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

**Reporting, Analytics & Insights**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
* Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
* Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

**CS Ops & Leadership Partnership**

* Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
* Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
* Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey

$18 - $22 hourly

* **Client Intake & Compassionate Listening:** Gather preliminary information from prospective clients, showing empathy and patience while ensuring they feel heard and valued.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Analytics, Operations, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience with Medicare Advantage or ACA encounter data processes and/or risk adjustment experience with a Payer, Vendor or Provider Organization

jobs.title: Patient Access Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Abax Health is a healthcare technology company dedicated to enhancing the patient's financial experience through data-driven engagement. Our platform and tech-enabled services enable hospitals and health systems to identify patients at financial risk, personalize outreach, and optimize patient access operations. By combining empathy with innovation, we empower providers to improve outcomes and drive operational performance.

**Mission & Vision**

Ensure that every patient receives the care they need, when they need it. To be the trusted source of patient access innovation increasing revenue and transforming patient access and financial clearance by reducing administrative burdens, uncovering untapped revenue, and improving the financial and clinical outcomes for patients and health systems across the United States.

**Location:** United States | Remote

**Location Eligibility:** Candidates must currently reside in the United States. This role is not available to residents of California, New Jersey, New York, Montana, Hawaii, or Alaska, or of any U.S. territory.

**Summary**

The Patient Access Manager leads Abax Health’s remote Patient Access operations across assigned client partners. Reporting to the Director of Patient Access Operations, this role leads supervisors who oversee patient registration, insurance verification, prior authorization, and scheduling teams. The Patient Access Manager is also the escalation point for performance, employee relations, and client concerns.

You will turn operational data into decisions. Supervisors handle day-to-day issues and produce reports. You analyze those reports to determine whether SLAs are being met, what is driving trends, and when to escalate to the client. You will use both spreadsheets and AI tools for this work, including building your own dashboards and agents.

This role suits an experienced Patient Access leader who is energized by a growing company. At Abax, managers partner closely with leadership during new client implementations and go-lives, then stabilize and grow the team after launch. You will support multiple clients and work alongside multiple leaders, and teamwork is central to how we operate.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Patient Access Supervisors and the teams they support.
* Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and professional growth.
* Serve as the escalation point for corrective actions, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and terminations, in partnership with HR.
* Participate in interviewing and selecting Patient Access staff and supervisors.
* Build a team culture grounded in collaboration, ownership, and commitment to patient care.

**Patient Access Operations Oversight**

* Oversee team performance in patient registration, insurance verification, prior authorizations, and appointment scheduling.
* Ensure standardized workflows are carried out consistently across assigned client programs.
* Identify workflow inefficiencies and put scalable process improvements in place.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, client requirements, SLAs, and organizational policies.
* Ensure staff recognize when a conversation needs a qualified medical interpreter, such as clinical or consent discussions, and follow established interpreter and language access procedures.

**Performance Reporting and Analytics**

* Analyze supervisor-generated and system reports to evaluate SLA performance, productivity, quality, and work inventory.
* Identify upward and downward trends, determine root causes, and build action plans with supervisors.
* Escalate risks to clients proactively, such as work inventory shortages or performance gaps.
* Use Excel and AI tools, such as Claude, to build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting agents.
* Prepare clear, data-driven performance reporting for Abax leadership and client partners.

**Client Partnership and Implementation**

* Serve as a primary operational contact for assigned clients.
* Partner with leadership during new client implementations and go-lives, setting expectations with staff and clients before launch.
* Participate in client meetings, performance reviews, and issue resolution.
* Support onboarding of new clients, workflows, and technologies as Abax grows.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain process documentation and best practices.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve patient experience and operational outcomes.
* Adapt to changing client and payer requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Bilingual Team Support (bilingual candidates only, not required)**

* Serve as a Spanish-language resource for supervisors and staff working bilingual lines.
* Support quality review of Spanish-language patient interactions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* 3+ years of experience leading leaders, such as supervisors or team leads.
* 1+ year of direct supervisory experience in Patient Access.
* Experience overseeing teams that perform insurance verification, prior authorizations, and patient scheduling.
* Patient Access Manager experience or higher in a hospital, physician practice, healthcare call center, or similar patient-facing setting.
* Hands-on experience with electronic medical record (EMR) systems.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret reports and turn findings into action.
* Willingness to learn and use AI tools in daily work, including building dashboards and agents.
* Experience handling employee relations matters, including corrective action and performance improvement.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with limited day-to-day oversight.

**Preferred**

* College’s degree.
* Fluency in spoken and written Spanish and English. This is preferred, not required. Candidates who list Spanish fluency will complete a language proficiency assessment during the hiring

jobs.title: Practice Management Implementation Specialist

The **Practice Management Implementation Specialist** plays a critical role in supporting our New York Customers. This includes gathering requirements, writing specifications, and testing scheduling, billing, clinical, and reporting features tailored to the unique needs of behavioral health providers. You will work closely with customers and the development team to ensure requests are captured accurately and delivered successfully.

  

This role is well suited for someone who works carefully within defined standards, documents work thoroughly, and can move steadily between customer needs, system requirements, and implementation follow-through.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support customer requests for NY EHRs through discovery, requirements gathering, specification, testing, and delivery.
* Participate in discovery sessions with customer stakeholders and document current-state workflows, requirements, and open questions.
* Write functional specifications for assigned features, including business rules, worked examples, and edge cases.
* Apply technical and operational knowledge to perform software and integration testing of implemented solutions.
* Build and execute test cases for newly implemented features, using realistic data across multiple scenarios.
* Resolve identified issues requiring changes to implemented software applications and solutions.
* Document defects and evidence clearly, and drive them to closure.
* Verify data flow and mapping between EHR platforms to confirm information transfers correctly.
* Work closely with the development team in gathering and reviewing customer feedback and requirements.
* Prepare customer-facing documentation, including user guides, quick-reference sheets, and release notes.
* Deliver end-user training and support during and after the implementation process.
* Maintain the request log and provide routine status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Handle protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and company policy.
* Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
Ability to travel up to 25% as needed.  

  
  

### **Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Behavioral Health, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in a business analyst, QA analyst, implementation, or application-support role for customer-facing software, preferably in behavioral health or human services settings.
* Ability to gather detailed requirements and translate them into clear, structured functional specifications
* Strong testing discipline, including deriving test cases from requirements and documenting results with supporting evidence
* Comfort working within regulated environments that require accuracy, documentation, and adherence to established standards
* Ability to manage multiple requests and workstreams while maintaining follow-through and quality
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for customer sessions, internal coordination, documentation, and training
* Sound problem-solving skills with a practical, methodical approach to issue resolution
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with customers, developers, and internal stakeholders
* Strong understanding of healthcare workflows, revenue-cycle concepts, and front-office operations

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with behavioral health EHR platforms.
* Working familiarity with New York behavioral-health programs and payment methodologies, including NY Medicaid, OMH/OASAS, APG, CCBHC PPS and OTP.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and other behavioral health compliance standards.
Relevant certifications such as CBAP/CCBA, CSPO/CSM, PMP, or ISTQB/CSTE.  

  
  

### **Benefits**

  
  

**Fully Remote Workforce**

As a virtual-first organization, we can attract the best talent no matter where we all live. This allows for added flexibility and a schedule that works for you.

  

**Essential Benefits**

We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance; 40l(k) with match; legal benefits; short-term and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; and paid time off.

Team members can reward each other with points to celebrate everyday wins and going above and beyond. It’s our way of saying “nice job” in a way that really sticks.

Employees can benefit financially through the company’s success, referring top talent, and performance-based bonuses.

**Operations** **Manager**
--------------------------

**Position Classification**: Exempt, full-time, benefits eligible

**Accountable to:** Program Director

**Operations Manager Position Description:**

Under the direct supervision of the Program Director, the Operations Manager (OM) works collaboratively with all staff to facilitate and supervise the orchestration of daily operations related to client treatment and care on behalf of the Program Director and clinical team under the auspices of all prevailing Pathway Society policies and procedures. The Operations Manager reports and documents major incidents and concerns around documentation, workflow, client needs, staff performance, and crisis interventions to the director. The OM is a problem solver who can delegate, resolve, direct and instruct staff and clients in a respectful, positive, and goal-oriented fashion. The Operations Manager is responsible for the initial mediation, crisis prevention/intervention and maintaining *daily* workflow. While the OM is the first contact in the milieu, they do not create, change, or decide the interpretation of policies, curriculum, infractions, discharges, or staff disciplinary actions.

**Operations Manager Primary Responsibilities**:

* Work with care coordinators (CC), withdrawal management staff, reception, and intake to refine client movement and communication amongst team members and clients.
* Work with clinical teams to manage CCs client relationships.
* Report and answer directly to program director on daily issues and concerns related to CC, counselors, and client care.
* Collaborate with clinical supervisor daily to assist clinical team.

* Assist in facilitating medical needs for staff and clients with nurse and doctor in a timely fashion; communicate with medical, clinical and transport for client daily concerns; and Organize med and transport and fill in as needed.
* Conduct daily facility inspections for cleanliness, general condition, and damage.
* Be an ambassador by being visible for client and staff contact within the milieu.
* Broadly ensure the status of linen, toiletries, sanitation supplies and collaborate with culinary staff for any emerging needs.
* Collaborate and assist clinical, medical, intake and WM needs with county services, RR/OP, health agencies as needed including ALOC, transition, and referrals.
* Facilitate peer groups as necessary during clinical team absence or clinical crisis interventions.
* On a periodic basis, fill in during emergency scheduling issues that have no other staffing resolution available.
* Inspect CC work for compliance with PSI documentation and required paperwork.

Conduct shift change meetings (counselors train CC on techniques for client interaction).

* Refine daily client schedule to remove obstacles for groups, meals, breaks, transit, family visits, and drop offs.
* Review daily LOG of scheduled events not in the daily client treatment schedule and coordinate activities as necessary.
* Navigate and delegate daily crisis concerns with staff and resolve issues for staff to maintain workflow, client care, and productivity.
* Recognize initial conflicts with staff, clients and staff, client to client relations, and direct them to clinical team or director for resolution as necessary.
* Document all incidents with staff and/or clients and refer to the program director.
* Report any breech PSI policies by staff or clients to director; concerns with staff needs; and infractions and disciplinary issues.
* Monitor staff and client compliance within PSI policies, paperwork, procedures and intervene with redirection towards proper interaction, procedure, compliance, and workflow.
* Under the direction and guidance of the program director, create a training binder and maintain weekly staff training for procedures and paperwork, emotional regulation strategies, motivational interviewing trauma-informed techniques, meeting people where they are at, positive employee behavior, navigating technology, and professional affect policies.
* Under direction of the program director, consolidate PSI paperwork to decrease confusing clutter and increase workflow performance.
* Audit client case files for county compliance as necessary and directed.

* Clinical experience and degree required
* CADC/equiv. and/or Bachelor's degree required
* Experience working with mental health and substance use disorder populations required.
* Ability to work peacefully and cooperatively as a member of the team.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills including use of computerized word and electronic health record data base.
* Ability to work effectively with people differing in value systems, ethnicity, cultural backgrounds, language capabilities, and disabilities.
* Mastery of utilizing tact and diplomacy in disputes; exercising good judgment; and responding calmly in emergency situations.
* Must pass comprehensive background check, reference check, and possess a valid driver license, current auto liability insurance and a clean driving record.

The employee frequently is required to stand; climb stairs; walk; use hands to finger, handle, and type and occasionally lift supplies, up to 20 pounds.

new_jobs.title: Fire Operations Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
**About BurnBot**  
BurnBot provides systematic fuels treatment services to prevent destructive wildfires. We're firefighters, scientists, engineers, prescribed fire practitioners, ecologists, and community members who are answering the call to scale fuel treatment capacity. Our modern fuel treatment system recognizes and supports conservation efforts with a clean, smoke-free process. We need technology to amplify our workforces with targeted use of synthetic fire to treat fuel loads 10x faster than previously possible.

  

**The Role**  
BurnBot is seeking a Fire Operations Specialist (FOS) to perform middle leadership oversight within the Fire Program. This role mixes supervisory oversight of BurnBot Fire Modules with responsibility for field-based project operational oversight as well as performing client-focused tasks.

  

This role, while in the field a majority of the time, may be based in Placerville, CA, Medford, OR, or our South San Francisco, CA Headquarters.

  

Administrative tasks include day to day management of 5-person Fire Modules. The FOS will have primary responsibility for recruitment and retention of 1-3 Modules as well as performing supervisory duties including onboarding, ensuring administrative tasks are carried out to BurnBot standards, providing performance feedback, coordinating training, and providing direction leadership in lieu of the Module Leader when they are unavailable. The FOS will help to coordinate Module mobilizations as well as their own in coordination with other FOS and Fire overhead.

  

Field based tasks will include:

* Planning for and/or execution of prescribed fire (broadcast burning, pile burning, air curtain burning, RX2/PFV burning, etc)
* Module leadership for wildfire mobilization and/or mobilization coordination across multiple types of equipment (Type 5 or 6 engines, chippers, heavy equipment, etc)
* Conducting or coordinating Defensible Space Inspections
* The FOS is expected to serve as a project manager/POC or Burn Boss for field projects and maintain a consistent field presence to support Fire Modules, evaluate conditions, and ensure alignment between planning and execution.

* Performs job walks and field verification for proposal building
* In coordination with organizational stakeholders, ensure all projects comply with OSHA, environmental regulations, and fire requirements
* Maintains day-to-day relationship touchpoints at the site and project level
* Captures issues early and escalates effectively through the Fire Director staff or Program leads
* Maintains project artifacts including scope documentation, maps/GIS inputs, schedules, and acceptance checklists
* Other duties as assigned

  

Administrative Tasks:

* Customer management including developing and maintaining relationships with current and potential clients.
* Help to develop proposal budgets, project implementation schedules, and scopes of work.
* Unique skills and qualifications that the FOS possesses will be incorporated into their workload as needed for related BurnBot work.

  

The FOS splits time approximately 40/60% between administrative responsibilities and field engagement. This role serves as the critical operational bridge between Fire Modules and the Director Staff level.

  

This is an exempt role with a salary of $123,000 to $140,000 per year. Placement within the range depends on experience, certifications, and skills.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Directly oversee and support Fire Modules across multiple crews and/or project sites including directly managing modules as needed
* Ensure consistent execution of company standards related to safety, quality, productivity, and professionalism
* Provide guidance, direction, and corrective action to Fire Module leadership
* Maintain oversight of safety performance across all assigned operations
* Ensure compliance with burn plans, project plans, safety policies, and regulatory requirements
* Review incidents, near misses, and safety reports; implement corrective actions and improvements
* Reinforce stop-work authority and risk management expectations at all levels
* Own and manage all required operational reporting (i.e. Production, Safety, Equipment, Labor, Budget, etc.)
* Participate in job walks, pre-bid site visits, and scope development
* Support long-range operational planning, including staffing needs, equipment acquisition, and seasonal workload balancing
* Serve as a primary point of contact between field operations and BurnBot Directors
* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to travel extensively (up to 60%)
* Valid driver's license and ability to be insured under company policy (this role requires driving company vehicles and trailers to remote job sites)
* Minimally qualified as an NWCG ENGB or CRWB, ICT5, and RXB3
* 5+ years of experience in forestry, fuels mitigation, vegetation management, or wildland fire operations in the public or private sector
* Demonstrated experience supervising fire crews or foremen
* Experience working with public agencies and regulatory bodies
* Strong working knowledge of prescribed fire operations, wildfire operations, and field safety standards
* Proven ability to manage reporting, documentation, and operational planning
* Physical ability to perform demanding field work (lifting up to 50 lbs, uneven terrain, long days outdoors)

  

Desired Qualifications

* Any of the following NWCG certifications: FIRB, RXB2/1, CRWB, ENGB, TFLD, DIVS, ICT4
* Experience in wildland firefighting and prescribed burning
* Experience operating farm, forestry, or other heavy equipment, trucks and large trailers
* Experience supporting proposal development and estimating
* Bachelor’s Degree in Forestry, Fire Science, Natural Resources, or related field
* NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist
* GIS Data Analysis

  

Still interested? Please apply at BurnBot.com/Careers or by sending your resume to careers@burnbot.com.

**What to Expect**

Tesla is seeking a Program Manager to own North America Service repair quality. The focus of this work is changing from all customer comebacks to 3x comebacks: customers who return three or more times. This role makes that number one the field trusts, finds why those cars come back, and changes the process and the behavior that cause the return. You will not own the repair, the diagnosis engine, or the parts catalog. You will partner across Field, Training, Field Technical Support, Warranty, and Analytics so a failed repair becomes rarer, not just better documented.

The ideal candidate is credible with technicians, has the grit to stay on a stubborn comeback number, and the horsepower to separate a bad repair from a bad part, a bad process, or a bad handoff.

This role is based in Palo Alto, CA or Austin, TX, for proximity to Service Engineering, Training, and partner teams. It reports into Service Operations.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own Tesla Service repair-quality performance for North America, with the focus shifting to 3x comebacks, and run the plan that moves that metric
* In the first 30 days, learn the repair path end to end — from the correction on the visit through parts, the work itself, quality check, delivery, and the visit that comes back — in the tools and in a service center
* In the first 60 days, make the 3x comeback metric trustworthy: definition, source, owner, and what counts as a third return versus a single comeback, a new concern, a parts delay, or a customer choice
* Find the systemic drivers: standard work, handoff from diagnosis, parts, site process. Do not stop at “the technician missed it”
* Identify the technicians, sites, and habits that are actually movable, and drive adoption. A note in the bulletin is not a result
* Build one view with Business Analytics so the field, Training, and leadership are looking at the same repairs
* Partner with Field Technical Support, Training, Warranty, and Service Engineering without waiting for a perfect org chart; Report regularly to senior leadership on the number, what was tested, and what is next

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Track record of taking an untrusted quality or comeback metric and making it clean enough that the people who do the work will use it
* Has ramped on a repair, warranty, or field-service operation — tools and shop floor — in about 30 days. Sat with the people who do the job, not only read the process
* Changed technician or site behavior on quality, with a clear view of who, where, and what actually moved. Coached, did not police
* High EQ with technicians and managers. Can push a hard quality number without making the shop the enemy
* Sharp analytical horsepower: finds the real driver in noisy repair data. Comfortable with SQL or similar, and can size an opportunity on the spot
* 5+ years of program or operations management, ideally in automotive service, field service, warranty, or repair quality
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, including comfort presenting to senior leadership; Willingness to travel up to 25% to service centers

new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Intellectual Property Law, Environmental Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of professional experience in the electronic consumer product scrap and recycling industry.
* 2 years of experience in asset disposition.
* 2 years of experience in a management or program leadership role.
* Experience in vendor performance management and contract administration.
* Experience developing and deploying security programs around confidential prototypes and unreleased products.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* R2, CSDS (Certified Secure Destruction Specialist) or CPP (Certified Protection Professional).
* Experience with "demanufacturing" processes—knowing exactly how to take apart a proprietary device to extract value without compromising secrets.
* Deep understanding of and experience in loss prevention/asset protection, conducting security risk assessments, physical security systems and processes, investigations, and corrective action planning (CAPA), writing and implementing security standards, along with basic understanding of EHS work flows and waste control regulations.
* Demonstrated high ethical standards with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately, with excellent judgment, discretion, and diplomacy.
* Ability to travel domestically or internationally.

**About the job**
-----------------

We are seeking a Global Destruction Program Manager to design, implement, and oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our most sensitive physical assets. This is not just a waste management role; it is a critical security function. You will be responsible for ensuring that prototypes, defective/decommissioned high-value components, proprietary pieces of hardware, devices, components and materials are rendered non-recoverable. You will lead a global network of certified vendors, ensuring that our intellectual property never leaks, ends up on the secondary market or in the hands of competitors.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $157000 - $227000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain global Secure Destruction SOPs aligned with security leadership, ensuring compliance with international trade, local laws, and data privacy regulations.
* Source, manage, and physically audit global destruction, smelting, and recycling partners via unannounced site visits to guarantee compliance.
* Classify critical Alphabet IP to define destruction standards, deploying RFID/GPS tracking to maintain end-to-end chain of custody through final certification.
* Conduct risk assessments, threat benchmarking, and lead investigations into asset leaks, theft, or grey-market breaches alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
* Leverage AI tools and program metrics to drive operational efficiency, scale secure workflows, and continuously modernize scrap destruction practices.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**POSITION / TITLE:** Client Services Coordinator

**MISSION:**

Meals on Wheels of San Francisco provides a network of services that allows seniors to live in their homes with dignity and independence as long as possible.

**ABOUT MOWSF:**

MOWSF is committed to the belief that all seniors have the right to live independently with dignity and respect in their own homes, for as long as safely possible. It is our mission to provide isolated homebound seniors in San Francisco with nutritious meals, daily human contact, and supportive services to prevent their premature institutionalization.

**Position Summary:**

The Client Services Administrative Coordinator provides client communication, administrative, and operational support across assigned MOWSF programs, supporting Home-Delivered Meals (HDM). This position serves as a point of contact for clients, caregivers, drivers, staff, and community partners; coordinates service inquiries, provides timely follow-up; and maintains accurate client information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

The coordinator assists with service changes, delivery questions, documentation, and cross-department communication and issues Drivers encounter during deliveries. Depending on program needs, assignments may include client intake, Safety Board support, driver communications and delivery coordination, spreadsheets, and other administrative activities. The position requires dependability, sound judgment, creative problem-solving, calm demeanor, attention to detail, and the ability to balance phone coverage with deadline-driven work. The coordinator must demonstrate initiative, independently assess situations, identify solutions, and effectively utilize available resources and team collaboration to resolve issues.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Client Communications & Service Support***

* Respond promptly and professionally to incoming calls, emails, and inquiries from clients, caregivers, drivers, service providers, and the public.
* Provide accurate information about program services, meal deliveries, estimated delivery arrival times (ETAs), delivery schedules, and applicable procedures.
* Document and help resolve delivery complaints, missed deliveries, service questions, and client requests; driver issues, follow established scripts and escalation protocols.
* Route time-sensitive or specialized concerns to the Social Worker of the Day, operations, other program staff, or appropriate internal departments, including Human Resources for staff-related matters.
* Use respectful communication and de-escalation skills when assisting individuals with complex or sensitive concerns.

***Client Records & Administrative Coordination***

* Enter, review, and update client information and service requests in Salesforce and other approved systems, maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.
* Process or coordinate temporary suspensions, restarts, cancellations, disenrollments, delivery schedule changes, and other authorized service updates.
* Monitor assigned email inboxes and task queues, track follow-up needs, and complete assigned work within established timelines. Prepare, save, organize, and send professional emails, client notices, letters, spreadsheets, reports, and electronic documents.
* Maintain data logs and spreadsheets, support data entry and quality checks, and assist with reporting or special projects.

***Delivery & Safety Operations Support***

* Communicate with delivery drivers and operations staff to relay client instructions, clarify delivery concerns, and coordinate follow-up.
* Assist with driver confirmation calls, Safety Board coverage, missed-delivery outreach, and related documentation as trained and assigned.
* Escalate potential client safety concerns promptly using established procedures and designated staff contacts.

***Program & Team Support***

* Assist with program intake, enrollment, client starts, and other administrative processes as assigned.
* Coordinate requests with social work, intake, delivery operations, and other departments to support continuity of service.
* Share workload information, offer or request coverage as appropriate, and contribute to a respectful, collaborative office environment.
* Support organizational events, program changes, special projects, and other related
    
  duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Relevant customer service, client support, administrative or similar work experience; an associate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred.
* Working proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive, including drafting emails, editing documents, managing files, and maintaining spreadsheets.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, follow established procedures,
    
  and escalate urgent issues appropriately.

* Experience in a nonprofit, social service program, call center, dispatch center, or client-facing administrative setting.
* Bilingual proficiency in Cantonese

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Beacon's talent function is scaling fast, running in parallel across corporate functions and a growing roster of independently operated portfolio companies. Supporting each one of those searches are the systems and processes behind it: clean Ashby data, funnel and data reporting, and coordination that doesn't drop a candidate between steps. We're looking for a **Recruiting Operations Lead** to own that infrastructure end-to-end, and to build it right the first time, rather than retrofit in the future.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Own Ashby.** Configuration, workflows, integrations, and data hygiene are yours end-to-end, not a shared responsibility with whoever has time.
* **Build the reporting layer.** Funnel metrics, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and hiring velocity, dashboards recruiters, executives, GMs, and hiring leadership use to make decisions.
* **Process design.** Turn how Beacon hires today into documented, repeatable workflows that hold up as the team and portfolio grow.
* **Coordination backbone.** Partner closely with our Recruiting Coordinator to keep scheduling, candidate communications, and interview logistics clean, especially with multiple portco searches running at once.
* **AI & automation.** Identify and deploy tooling that reduces admin burden across candidate screening and scheduling. This might branch out to other areas including sourcing, and post interview decisions and offer workflows.
* **Candidate experience.** Standardize the candidate journey across corporate and portco searches with a consistently high bar.
* **Cross-functional glue.** Work with VP of Talent and Finance on headcount planning and with legal/People partners on offer letters, background checks, and clean handoffs.
* **Data hygiene at holdco scale.** Every portfolio company's reqs, candidates, and hires need to roll up cleanly into one picture. You build that structure now, not after it's already messy.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in recruiting operations, HR technology, or business systems administration, with real ownership of an ATS (Ashby strongly preferred).
* Comfort building process from scratch, not optimizing an existing one. Beacon's talent function is new; you'll be writing the manual, not editing it.
* A strong analytical mindset. You can build a dashboard, but more importantly, you know which metric actually changes a decision.
* Systems thinking. You can map how a change in one workflow ripples through downstream reporting and integrations before you make it.
* Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, small-team, multi-entity environment. No two portfolio companies operate the same way.
* Excellent cross-functional communication; you'll work directly with the Talent, Department Heads/Managers, Finance, and People partners across a holding company structure.
* Bachelor's degree, or additional years of experience in lieu.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in a PE-backed or multi-entity/holdco environment, where recruiting ops had to serve several operationally independent businesses at once.
* Experience standing up recruiting ops and systems from scratch (0-to-1), not just optimizing a mature function.
* Experience partnering with a lean recruiting coordination function to keep logistics tight without a large ops team behind you.

**Our Values at Beacon Software**

* Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.
* Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.
* Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.
* Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.

***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.*

***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*
